description:
Goal
Build TransportPlan(root) independently from SemanticClosed(root), settled RuntimeDemand, types, lowered flow evidence, and callsite/capture facts. The old layout path stays alive for behavior, but the new plan must not depend on it.

Required facts
TransportPlan owns root closure membership, TransportPosition -> ShapeId for executable inputs, returns, delivered resumes, entry captures, body values, call args, and continuation payload positions. RuntimeDemand::Ignore becomes Shape::Nothing exactly once here. Producer return and consumer resume positions must point to the same ShapeId for the same delivered value. Local ignored-use facts may drop lanes later, but cannot rewrite the received shape.

Source rule
Derive from SemanticClosure.runtime_demands, ActivationAnalysis.value_types, lowered bodies, callsite summaries, executable frontier, and flow edges. Do not read RuntimeValueLayout, RuntimeInputLayout, ReturnAbi, DeliveredShape, NativeDemandAbi, RealizedValue, or codegen surfaces.

Telemetry
Emit transport-flow construction counts: roots, executable symbols, transport positions, shape nodes, Nothing nodes, lanes, tuple nodes, callable nodes, and producer/resume shared-shape assertions.

Checks
The worked-example test from fz-hwn.20.1 passes against the real plan. Targeted fixtures prove ignored values, tuple-field return/resume, and direct-callable return/resume positions. cargo check --all-targets.
title: Transport flow graph: derive root TransportPlan from semantic evidence only
